Step 5 throws a TypeError when the status is false. Step 6 returns obj. Each step keeps its spec comment above the code for it. The only remaining gap is Proxy [[SetPrototypeOf]], which the gate report shows failing with the engine's not-implemented error. That is an honest partial, not a defect.
